attacker_pocs.name: hinted_bytes_copy_overread
attacker_pocs.why: A valid EXR bytes attribute with one payload byte and a one-byte type hint reaches BytesAttribute through MultiPartInputFile. Header insertion copies the attribute. The shipped copy constructor includes the type-hint length in the payload memcpy count, reading and writing past one-byte allocations. The upstream fix copies only the payload length.

role_a_rationale: Both constructor copies skip zero-length payloads, matching the upstream repair intent. The shipped copy constructor also counts type-hint bytes when copying the separately stored payload. This creates one heap-buffer-overflow for a valid hinted, nonempty bytes attribute; the golden constructor copies exactly the payload size. The change touches only the upstream fix site. Four focused sanitizer checks passed; a broader run passed 133 of 134 tests before the long final threading test was stopped.
